landing.hero_a: A pixel world made from a random seed
landing.tag: A tiny pixel world that lives on its own, until you decide it shouldn't.
landing.soon: Concept preview. The game is still being built.
landing.god_h: You are the god. The world doesn't wait for you.
landing.god_p: Four races, 32 creatures and 21 biomes share one map. Villagers are born, farm, marry, pray, argue and go to war. Kingdoms rise and fall with or without you. Step in with a meteor, a blessing or a plague, and watch what happens next.
landing.world_p: Top down pixel art that reads from a whole continent down to a single villager. Kingdom colors show who owns what at a glance.
landing.mock_a: Four kingdoms share a continent while a dragon circles a capital
landing.i_quote: “The mountain gave us iron. The elves gave us trouble.”
landing.races_p: Each race has its own land, strengths and habits. Children inherit genes from both parents, and isolated groups can become new subspecies.
landing.humans_d: Balanced, fast learners, build the biggest kingdoms. They can settle anywhere.
landing.elves_d: Best archers and long lived. They plant forests instead of cutting them.
landing.orcs_d: Strong, fearless and quick to breed. They start more wars.
landing.dwarves_d: Tough miners and smiths. They tunnel through mountains.
landing.beasts_p: From sheep to dragons. Some are food, some are danger, and one is a giant crab you can drive through a city.
landing.sheep_d: Grazes on grassland and flees wolves.
landing.wolf_d: Hunts in packs and chases lone villagers.
landing.slime_d: Splits in two every time it is hit.
landing.ghost_d: Drifts through walls and scares people away.
landing.dragon_d: Breathes fire, raids towns and hoards gold.
landing.claw_d: A giant crab you can steer through a city. Stomp, sweep, laser.
landing.ufo_d: Abducts people and sometimes returns them changed.
landing.build_p: Every building has its own roof and shape, so you can tell a smithy from a temple from across the map.
landing.house_d: Homes grow from huts into stone houses as a village ages.
landing.temple_d: Priests gather faith here. Bigger temples are heard louder.
landing.smithy_d: Dwarves forge tools and weapons here. Smoke means work.
landing.keep_d: The seat of a kingdom, flying its colors.
landing.mine_d: Copper, iron and gold. The usual reason for war.
landing.bio_p: Twenty one biomes, from grassland to haunted battlefields, including rare magic patches. A few of them:
landing.forest_d: Wood and berries. Bears and deer.
landing.desert_d: Hot and dry. Gold flecks, little food.
landing.tundra_d: Cold and sparse. Foxes and penguins.
landing.haunted_d: Corruption spreads. Undead walk at night.
landing.pow_p: About 60 powers, each with a brush size and an effect you can see in under a tenth of a second.
landing.shape_d: Raise land, paint biomes, drop a volcano.
landing.grace_d: Bless, heal, bring rain, work a miracle.
landing.gene_d: Mutate, add traits, split a subspecies.
landing.wld_d: Pause, speed up, save, start over.
landing.war_h: Raise armies. Or let them raise themselves.
landing.war_p: Barracks train soldiers, generals lead them, and kingdoms fight wars on their own. Take command any time: pick an army, tap the map, and it marches.
landing.war_a: A human army marches on an orc wall while archers shoot from the battlements
landing.a_sub: Human kingdom, at war with the Redtusk Orcs
landing.pos_p: Possess a single villager and play them like an action game. The world keeps running around you. A farmer is weak. A champion is not.
landing.story_p: Every named person, war and religion goes into the chronicle. Here is what a few idle centuries might look like.
landing.l1: Year 31The Redtusk Orcs declare war on the Hill Dwarves over a copper mine.
landing.l2: Year 88Cut off by a mountain range, one orc clan becomes the Ashfoot Orcs.
landing.l3: Year 140A UFO abducts a priest and returns him with a new religion.
landing.l4: Year 203Clawzilla wrecks the capital of Elmwick. The elves replant it.
landing.l5: Year 344A dwarf smith forges the first mythril axe and names it Oathbreaker.
landing.tut_h: Never played a god game? Good.
landing.tut_p: A ten step tutorial runs the first time you play. Arrows point at the right button, and a checklist ticks itself off as you go. Replay it any time.
landing.s3: Spawn humans and watch them build
landing.road_p: The game is built in phases, and every phase ends in a build you can play. Follow along on GitHub.
landing.r0_d: The execution plan and this page.
landing.r1_d: Repository, build pipeline and automatic publishing.
landing.r2_d: Generator, biomes, renderer, camera, terrain tools, saves.
landing.r3_d: Animals, 4 races, genes, minds, villages, roads.
landing.r4_d: Economy, tech ages, gear, culture, religion, diplomacy.
landing.r5_d: Armies, command tool, walls, towers, sieges, possession.
landing.r6_d: Disasters, monsters, Clawzilla, UFOs, zombies, nukes.
landing.r7_d: Charts, pyramids, war history, death stats, leaderboards.
landing.r8_d: Tutorial, Codex, achievements, sound, phone controls, balance.
landing.foot: Plays in any modern browser on desktop or phone, online or offline from one file. All art on this page is original and drawn in code.

play.title: Pocket Pantheon
play.hint: We are still building it. Check the roadmap to see how far along it is.
